bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks are prohibited, as are bags longer than 14 inches on their longest side. Small purses are permitted after search; tour restrictions may be tighter.
allowed: Bag no longer than 14 inches on longest side
prohibited: Bags over 14 inches on longest side
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Public parking is north of the amphitheater at the OKC Zoo and Science Museum; a free show-day people-mover trolley runs from the zoo lot to the venue. Limited accessible parking off Meyers Place requires a placard.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Use the designated pickup and drop-off point in the OKC Zoo lot, entering OKC Zoo Drive from NE Grand Boulevard.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food vendors attend every concert and bars sell alcohol to guests aged 21 or older. Outside food and drinks are prohibited, with an exception for medically required items in sealed containers.
allowed: Medically necessary food or drink in sealed containers
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: An accessible viewing platform has tickets for a guest and companion. Limited accessible parking is near the entrance off Meyers Place; show a placard to the traffic attendant.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is not permitted unless the specific concert announces otherwise.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The venue says its show-day box office opens with doors but does not give a general Will Call collection procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The event page states the door and show times; guests pass a bag search and walk-through metal detectors at all entrances.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
